citations.quote: Consumer prices rose 2.9% year on year in September, down from 3.0% in August, as fuel prices fell.
Kestria's unemployment rate rose to 4.8% in September from 4.7% in August.
In the second quarter, revenue was EUR 2,960m and the operating margin 15.2%.
Sorvik Energy's third-quarter revenue rose to EUR 3,113m, while its operating margin fell to 13.9% as maintenance at two fields cut volumes and lifted unit costs.
For 2026, Corvo Telecom guides to an EBITDA margin of 37.5% to 38.5% and to capital expenditure of EUR 640m to EUR 680m.
The company raised its guidance for the 2026 EBITDA margin to 38.0% to 39.5%, and cut its capital expenditure guidance to EUR 620m to EUR 650m as network spending comes in below plan.
The Valdorian Central Bank raised its deposit rate by 25bp to 3.75% at its October meeting, as most economists had expected.
First-half gross margin was 38.2%, against 37.6% a year earlier, as the company bought better and cut markdowns.
